author: k.k.unfiltered
caption: Iykyk .. Yes, I have shorts on. The baddies who still wear Nike spandex get it..   IBS is learning how to function in public while your digestive system runs on its own schedule. Urgency isn’t about “holding it” — it’s a real gut–brain response that can show up with no warning, especially during stress, transitions, or when you’re about to leave the house. Outfits add a whole extra layer. Dresses, shapewear, jumpsuits — all cute, all inconvenient when your body decides it’s time now. People with IBS get used to planning exits, knowing where bathrooms are, and making fast adjustments while still trying to look normal on the outside. Follow me for honest, relatable IBS content, gut health education, and the everyday realities that don’t make it into polite conversation. #ibs #publicrestroom #poop #digestivehealth #guthealth  ⚠️ Disclaimer: This content is for educational and entertainment purposes only and reflects my personal experience. caption: A portable toilet has become one of my favorite car camping essentials.  It’s perfect for the middle of the night, cold mornings, or anytime I just don’t want to leave the comfort of my SUV. When I’m using my cot, I keep the toilet on a small rolling plant caddy so it slides in and out easily. Otherwise, I usually leave it stationary.
